root_cause_fixed: Windows PowerShell parsed `$code:` as a scoped variable reference and stopped before installation. The primary installer and launcher now use path-safe Python helpers instead of PowerShell, and the legacy PowerShell helper interpolation was also corrected.
boundary: The Windows BAT files cannot be double-clicked inside the Linux build environment. Their executable path now delegates to Python argv lists, eliminating CMD/PowerShell interpolation of the application path. Python helpers, dependency locks, wheel archives, databases, path round-trips and archive CRCs are verified before release.
